thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated error rates and token queueing observed for model family 'velvet-14b' in us-west-2. 90th pct latency > 2.4s for the last 3m and backend TPU contention spikes. Auto-sculpt triggered for other families. Paging oncall.

mike_oncall: got the page, looking. any customer-facing errors reported?

sara_ops: a few 429s from mobile-prod, support ticket #CS-8123 mentions slow chat replies. Not widespread 5xxs, mostly request throttles.

tim_sre: metrics look like bursty RPM/TPS coming from several small apps + a single heavy tenant. Per-model rate limiter for velvet-14b at 750tpm/80rpm currently.

jessica_platform: copying perf dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/serving/velvet-14b?from=now-15m to check KV cache hitrate. cache hitrate down to 32%.

mike_oncall: plan: do a targeted raise of TPM to 1200 and RPM to 200 for velvet-14b for 10m, and enable conservative prefix caching for that family. Will monitor errors and overall cluster load. If latency contours worsen, we'll rollback. @sara_ops can you open a canary route for the heavy tenant to throttle separately?

sara_ops: On it. Creating canary route and tagging heavy-tenant id=acme-inc. I'll route 30% of their traffic to a degraded config.

incident-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: runbook step 'adjust-per-model-quotas' pending. Use `rbxctl` or Console quick action.

tim_sre: mike -- before we bump, double-check model variant mapping. velvet-14b has two binaries (v1 q4 and v2 q5). Bumping TPM on v2 only might be cheaper.

mike_oncall: good call. I'll raise only the v2 variant. executing: ```
# increase tpm/rpm for velvet-14b v2
rbxctl quota set --model velvet-14b --variant v2 --tpm 1200 --rpm 200 --reason "live-mitigation 2991234567"
```

ops-bot: quota change accepted. Change id qchg-20260315-77. Applying now.

incident-bot: NOTE: quota change applied at 2991234615 by mike_oncall. Monitor window starts (10m).

jessica_platform: telemetry: latency 95th down from 2.4s -> 1.6s within 90s, queue depth reduced. KV cache warming slowly.

hana_support: support ticket updated: "We see improved speeds, thanks" — from customer ACME. Marking as partial mitigation.

sara_ops: canary route created. Heavy tenant 30% diverted, no errors in canary. Scaling looks stable.

mike_oncall: good. leaving the temporary quota for now, monitoring. set a timer for 10m and a rollback step if DB-backed quota usage spikes >15% on host nodes.

incident-bot: timer set: 10m (until 2991235215). Auto-alert if host token usage delta > 15%.

(5m later)

jessica_platform: slight CPU bump on nodes serving velvet-14b v2, but within headroom. No increase in 500s. KV cache hitrate now 58%.

tim_sre: noticed another model family 'cobalt-7b' is seeing increased latency correlated with routing shifts; might be neighbor noise. Recommend adding a soft cap on cobalt-7b to protect critical low-latency tiers.

mike_oncall: add soft sculpt: `rbxctl quota update --model cobalt-7b --rpm 120 --soft` — will create a gentle backpressure without hard failing.

ops-bot: quota update accepted qchg-20260315-78.

incident-bot: UPDATE: monitoring window extended 10m from 2991235215 because telemetry stable and customer impact reduced.

sara_ops: prod support: marking CS-8123 as mitigated, notifying account team.

mike_oncall: preparing handoff to night oncall in 30m. Summary for next oncall: velvet-14b v2 had temporary TPM/RPM increase (1200/200) applied at 2991234615, canary for heavy tenant, KV cache warming improved latency. Watch host token usage and neighbor-family cobalt-7b.

tim_sre: created follow-up ticket INF-4521 to investigate long-term fix: KV cache priming and smarter tenant shaping.

jessica_platform: also adding a perf alert: velvet-14b v2 95th > 2s for 5m -> auto rollback of v2 quota to previous values.

(handoff)
mike_oncall: handing off to @tim_sre in 10 for overnight. If alerts fire, first action: revert qchg-20260315-77 with: ```
rbxctl quota set --change-id qchg-20260315-77 --rollback --reason "auto/handback rollback"
```

tim_sre: ack, taking over. I'll keep the extended monitor until morning. ping me on pager for any regen. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: status=mitigated, impact=partial->resolved for kind=per-model-rate, summary="temporary quota bump + canary routing stabilized velvet-14b latency; follow-ups opened (INF-4521)".

mike_oncall: thanks team. leaving notes in #postmortems and will file short runbook tweak for variant-aware rate bumps.

sara_ops: adding a short customer-facing summary for ACME and CS-8123.

tim_sre: good work y'all.
